## Whats new

- **Security:** product names and brands (e.g. from Open Food Facts) are escaped before rendering — no more HTML injection
- **Stability:** card no longer crashes on items without brand/name, does not mutate Home Assistant state and re-renders only when the stock sensor changes
- **Visual editor:** "Apocalypse Stock Card" now appears in the card picker
- **Edit modal:** no longer overwritten by background state updates
- **Home Assistant compatibility:** no blocking file I/O in the event loop, Lovelace YAML mode handled gracefully, `update_stock` service validated and documented, items list excluded from the recorder database
- **Requirement:** Home Assistant 2024.7.0 or newer
